purpose: Check whether broad survey/geographic misregistration explains the retained source-ground contact problems before authoring further geological interfaces.

rights.serviceStatement: The National Map Downloader application allows free downloads of public domain, NAIP compressed orthoimagery in JPEG2000format for the conterminous United States.

inspection: Actual aerial and signed-frame overlay inspected. Main roof/terrace and curved-walk axes broadly agree. Some guest-wing/theater extents are obscured or approximate; no numerical survey accuracy or rigid fitted transform is asserted. Source coordinates/anchor/heading remain unchanged. The earlier stair, bedrock and river proxies require physical modeling, not a global terrain fit.
newModelGeometryBasedOn: Previously cleared Qualla waterfall/stair originals and original government HABS site/floor/section evidence. Aerial is a diagnostic check, not newly adopted model-fidelity evidence.
